archetypes.name: state-machine
archetypes.rationale: The diff introduces a new Python ship driver whose phase ordering, idempotent re-entry, and outcome routing are central to correctness.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the new Python ship-pr state machine for phase-order regressions against the planned checks, postbump, PR prep, flush, PR create, CI, merge, and postmerge flow. Pay special attention to idempotent re-entry after transient or needs-user exits, and to any hidden dependency on bash state files in the Python path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: runlogs
archetypes.rationale: The plan depends on subtle run-log manifest ordering, state-file-less probes, and committed log batch behavior before PR push.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the run-log integration points for state-file-less pre-push behavior, repo-root cwd handling, manifest status and pr_number ordering, and exactly-once postmerge flushing. Check whether report rendering, manifest recovery, and no-logs flags remain consistent between bash-compatible and Python paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-parity
archetypes.rationale: The implementation must preserve bash-compatible exit codes and behavior while adding a dormant Python path.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the Python driver and finalize behavior against the documented bash contracts in the plan and touched skill documentation. Focus on exit-code mapping, JSON fields, needs_user_reason handling, failed_run_id propagation, and whether default bash behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ci-merge
archetypes.rationale: The new driver coordinates PR creation, CI monitor handbacks, rebase-only reruns, merge short-circuits, and post_flush suppression.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the PR, CI, rebase, and merge integration for double-push, double-flush, missed rebase, or wrong short-circuit behavior. Verify that merge_pr post_flush handling, CI monitor actions, and autonomous CI-fix handback data line up with the Step 8+ routing described in the plan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: finalize
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds finalize logic whose teardown, postmerge cleanup, and stalled-run behavior have high operational risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review finalize postbump, postmerge, and teardown behavior for parity with the expected post-merge and stalled-run contracts. Focus on no post-merge commits, no status=done writes inside postmerge, session and tmpdir guards, Branch A stalled preservation, and finalize-state handoff fields. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: runtime-cli
archetypes.rationale: The new Python entrypoint must remain runtime-safe, stdlib-only, and machine-readable for skill orchestration.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Python CLI, imports, environment parsing, dataclass defaults, and JSON stdout behavior for robustness and runtime compatibility. Look for non-stdlib runtime dependencies, fragile argparse or env conversions, noisy stdout that could break JSON parsing, and test gaps around these seams. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
